terms.comment: To punish, poenā afficere; to be punished, poenās dare (see punish).

terms.gloss: punishment, especially a severe one; the death penalty
terms.comment: Properly a kneeling down; usually of the death penalty (Lewis & Short), though the father in Terence uses it of a small punishment.

terms.gloss: correction, punishment (of a child or a pupil)

phrases.latin: Prō peccātō magnō paulum supplicī satis est patrī.
phrases.english: For a great wrong, a little punishment is enough for a father.

phrases.latin: Cavendum est etiam nē major poena quam culpa sit
phrases.english: One must also take care that the punishment is not greater than the fault
let the punishment fit the offence
